title: Black Myth: Wukong
description: A recent AAA action RPG split into six boss-gated chapters. VLM agents have handled individual fights from screenshots; no chapter clear has been reported.
clear_condition: Finish Chapter 6 and reach the end credits (either ending).
rules: Unmodified game, any difficulty and patch (state them). A chapter counts when its final boss is defeated and the chapter-end sequence plays.

attempts.name: VARP (Vision Action Role-Playing agent)
attempts.team: Peng Chen, Pi Bu, Jun Song, Yuan Gao, Bo Zheng
attempts.result: Screenshots in, keyboard and mouse out, with the game paused in photo mode while the model thinks. On 12 short Chapter 1 tasks, mostly fights, it wins about 90% of easy and medium fights. Against Bullguard it wins 20% of tries, a little above novice human players (15.63%). Walking to Bullguard within five minutes fails without human-guided examples and succeeds 40% of the time with them.
attempts.why_not: Single fights and short tasks inside Chapter 1, five tries each. No chapter was finished, so no milestone is reached.

attempts.name: CombatVLA
attempts.result: A small vision-language-action model trained for combat: game frames in, keyboard and mouse out, with the game paused while it thinks. Tested on 10 Wukong fights, from wolf guards up to Bullguard, Wandering Wight and Guangzhi, plus 3 Sekiro fights. It takes 1.85 s per decision against 90 s for VARP, and the authors report higher success than human players on their tasks.
attempts.why_not: Isolated fights only. No chapter was finished.
